title: Zaishen Coin
wikitext:
A [[Zaishen Coin]] is a [[reward trophy]] obtained by completing [[Zaishen Challenge Quest]]s, as a random [[drop]] from [[Zaishen Strongbox]]es or as a reward for completing certain non-Zaishen Challenge quests (e.g. [[The Rescue Attempt]]). They can be exchanged for goods (e.g. [[Zaishen Key]]s) or services (e.g. unlocking pet tiers in the [[Zaishen Menagerie]]). 

There are three types: Copper, Silver (worth 50 {{zcopper}}), and Gold (worth 10 {{zsilver}}).

== Notes ==
* The cost of 1 {{zgold}} is effectively 500 {{zcopper}} and 150 {{gold}}.
* Some of these items use unique text font colors. Whereas regular [[Item rarity|items' rarity]] is either shown with white, blue, purple, gold or green font, Copper Zaishen Coins use a special brown font and Silver Zaishen Coins a special grey font.
* Many of the lower tier items can be obtained for a fraction of the cost by selling the Zaishen Coins to another player and buying the item from a [[merchant]], [[trader]] or another player or crafting the item (e.g. Perfect Salvage Kit).

==Trivia==
* They were introduced in the [[Game updates/20090423|April 23, 2009 update]] and could not be [[trade]]d between [[account]]s until the [[Feedback:Game updates/20110602|June 2, 2011 update]].
